name: Can I replace my old kitchen sink with a different size or style?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace my old kitchen sink with a different size or style?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is often possible to replace your old kitchen sink with a different size or style, but it may require modifications to your countertop and/or cabinetry. For example, upsizing a sink or switching to a farmhouse style might necessitate cutting a larger opening in the countertop or altering the base cabinet. We can assess your current setup to determine the feasibility and discuss any structural adjustments needed.
